whatThisMeasures.estimator: expected[C, R] = SUM over cards ( count[C, card] / denominator[C] ) x isRole(card, R)
whatThisMeasures.summary: Mean-style expected count; not a percentile; does not feed a floor or go/no-go.

denominatorIntegrity.caveat: edhrec.csv aggregates by a single commander name while averages.csv carries solo rows and partner-pair rows, so a ratio above 1.0 proves the denominator is wrong for that commander and those commanders are excluded rather than clamped.

knownGaps: No bracket dimension exists in this archive.
Unresolved cards are excluded from classification and counted explicitly: 0.
`other` is excluded because it is a residual classifier-coverage bucket rather than a deck-construction target.
Classification is oracle-only via the shipped Cut Lab assigner call shape used by the other corpus arms.
A mean-style expected count cannot support a floor.
